content.title: Careers Old – United States Postal Inspection Service
content.text: Are you ready for a challenge? The Postal Inspection Service offers exciting career opportunities in a variety of disciplines. Every member of the agency serves with courage, integrity, and fierce loyalty to our country. If this sounds like you, join the Postal Inspection Service. Postal Inspectors Postal Inspectors are federal law enforcement agents with investigative jurisdiction in all criminal matters involving the integrity and security of the U.S. Postal Service®. Postal Inspectors investigate criminal, civil, and administrative violations of mail-related laws. Learn More Postal Police Officers Postal Police Officers are the uniformed division of the Postal Inspection Service. They perform a variety of duties pertaining to the security of postal buildings, personnel, property, mail, and mail-in-transit.
